variants.note: mlx-video (Apple Silicon only; README: "macOS with Apple Silicon"). Command: the README's "Dev two-stage HQ" example verbatim (line breaks removed) after its documented pip install, pinned to commit 87db56a. --model-repo prince-canuma/LTX-2-dev is the pre-converted MLX copy of the LTX-2 19B dev checkpoint that the README links ("Pre-converted weights are available on HuggingFace"); it downloads the repo's *.safetensors and *.json files, about 101 GB, instead of the 314 GB Lightricks/LTX-2 repo the default --model-repo fetches. The dev transformer matches this entry; the distilled checkpoint is catalogued as ltx-2-19b-distilled. name: Stable Diffusion v1.1

variants.cmd: uv run --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with torch python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-1', torch_dtype=torch.float16).to('cuda'); p('a cat holding a sign').images[0].save('out.png')"

uv run --with torch --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with safetensors python -c "from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-1').to('mps'); p.enable_attention_slicing(); p('A lighthouse at sunset', height=512, width=512).images[0].save('image.png')"

variants.note: stable-diffusion.cpp sd-cli, which its README lists with CPU, Metal, CUDA and Vulkan backends (prebuilt binaries on the releases page); download the listed files into models/. Files: sd-v1-1.ckpt 4.27 GB (CompVis/stable-diffusion-v-1-1-original@4af21d8). gb 2.1 = the ~2.1G that the stable-diffusion.cpp quantization doc gives for Stable Diffusion 1.x q8_0 txt2img at 512x512 (https://github.com/leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp/blob/3f8527a46c54ecf4cb4ed6003da8e8982283c73c/docs/quantization_and_gguf.md); higher than the 1.2 × weights + 0.5 GB rule. Command: the docs/sd.md txt2img example plus --type q8_0, which the quantization doc says converts weights while loading.

identity_note: CompVis/stable-diffusion-v1-1 checkpoint. params_b = 860M UNet (github.com/CompVis/stable-diffusion README); memory is the site's params x 2 bytes x 1.2 + 0.5 estimate.

name: DMOSpeech 2
provider: Columbia University / NewsBreak (Yinghao Aaron Li, Xilin Jiang et al.)

variants.cmd: conda create -n dmo2 python=3.10 && conda activate dmo2 && git clone https://github.com/yl4579/DMOSpeech2.git && cd DMOSpeech2 && pip install -r requirements.txt && mkdir ckpts && cd ckpts && wget https://huggingface.co/yl4579/DMOSpeech2/resolve/main/model_85000.pt && wget https://huggingface.co/yl4579/DMOSpeech2/resolve/main/model_1500.pt && cd ../src && python -c "from infer import DMOInference; import soundfile as sf; tts = DMOInference(student_checkpoint_path='../ckpts/model_85000.pt', duration_predictor_path='../ckpts/model_1500.pt', device='cuda', model_type='F5TTS_Base'); generated_audio = tts.generate(gen_text='I don\'t really care what you call me. I\'ve been a silent spectator, watching species evolve, empires rise and fall. But always remember, I am mighty and enduring.', audio_path='f5_tts/infer/examples/basic/basic_ref_en.wav', prompt_text='Some call me nature, others call me mother nature.'); sf.write('generated.wav', generated_audio, 24000)"
variants.note: official DMOSpeech2 repo (src/infer.py DMOInference, F5-TTS based), PyTorch. Platform evidence: Notebook: "device=\"cuda\","; infer.py teacher sampling: "with torch.autocast(device_type=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.float16):" (https://github.com/yl4579/DMOSpeech2/blob/10c2255a59b96c311c317536603a18672e… Command: README pre-requisite and checkpoint-download commands chained with &&; demo.ipynb cells 1-2 ('Basic Inference (teacher-guided, 8 steps)') wrapped as python -c run from src/ (the notebook's working dir): timing/RTF prints and IPython display dropped, output written with soundfile (a listed requiremen… gb is the sum of the weight files the command loads (model_85000.pt 4.02 GB; model_1500.pt 0.27 GB; pytorch_model.bin 0.05 GB); runtime memory is higher. Default (teacher-guided) sampling uses the bundled F5-TTS-architecture teacher inside model_85000.pt; student-only sampling is teacher_steps=0, student_start_step=0 (notebook).

identity_note: yl4579/DMOSpeech2 release @b2db04b (created 2025-07-21, the day after arXiv:2507.14988v1): model_85000.pt (DMD2-distilled student, bundles the F5-TTS-architecture teacher the authors trained themselves for 2M steps, used only for teacher-guided sampling) and model_1500.pt (GRPO-finetuned duration predictor). params_b is the paper's 0.3B for the student-only configuration. Card licence MIT. Not F5-TTS: the teacher is the authors' own training run, not a SWivid checkpoint. No copy-pasteable CLI (demo notebook only).
